notes.title: Major update v2.0
notes.content: [h2]Fiz and the Rainbow Planet v2.0 now available![/h2][p]The details of this update are as follows:[/p][p][/p][p][b]【English text support】[/b][/p][p]A language selection screen will now appear when you start the game for the first time.[/p][p]You can also change the language at any time by going to “Options → Other Settings → Language Settings.”[/p][p][b]【Mild Mode Added】[/b][/p][p]When enabled, the slightly strong expressions added in previous updates will be toned down.[/p][p]This setting is enabled by default, so if you want to play with the same expressions as in the previous version,[/p][p]please switch it off from “Options → Graphics Settings → MILD MODE.”[/p][p][b]【Other Changes】[/b][/p][p]• Reduced processing load on some stages[/p][p]• Various bug fixes[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43565882/65bcafe3d07b77414c059fad4d4dcc3f3c0dd856.png"][/img] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43565882/5da189d3fd32621e6d02c9c9a44d6d7b28ffa50b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43565882/b463c65d589149102044b07987b2d828bb7afbf9.png"][/img][/p]

tags.feature: A language selection screen will now appear when you start the game for the first time.
You can also change the language at any time by going to “Options → Other Settings → Language Settings.”
When enabled, the slightly strong expressions added in previous updates will be toned down.

This setting is enabled by default, so if you want to play with the same expressions as in the previous version,
please switch it off from “Options → Graphics Settings → MILD MODE.”

tags.balance_change: • Reduced processing load on some stages

notes.title: Minor update v1.5.2
notes.content:
This update includes the following:

・Added controller vibration support (Xbox-compatible controllers only).

notes.title: Major update v1.5.0
notes.content:
Fiz and the Rainbow Planet v1.5.0 Available now!

This update includes the following:

Addition of mini-games
Addition of theater room
Improved display settings
Addition of 16:9 frame
Other graphic enhancements
Other bug fixes

*If you have already cleared the main game, the mini-games will be unlocked when you play stages 2-2 and 3-3.
